# Registrations (spec 02 §4): rules 1–6, the guest, stale players, unknown coins.
config guest=1

# Rule 3: free slots fill up in order.
coin home 04000007 player=7
coin home 04000009 player=9
coin away 04000003 player=3
expect regs home=7,9 away=3,_

# Rule 1: the same player again (a second coin, or by hand) only adds a source.
add home 7
expect regs home=7,9 away=3,_

# Rule 2: the same player on the other side moves – nobody plays against himself.
coin away 04000077 player=7
expect regs home=_,9 away=3,7

# Rule 6: both players of a side are still there.
add away 5
expect error both players
expect regs home=_,9 away=3,7

# The guest may play several times at once.
add home 1
expect regs home=1,9 away=3,7
coin away 04000011 player=1          # a coin on a full side doesn't count (no error for a module)
expect regs home=1,9 away=3,7

# Stale: the button ejects the side's coins, the players stay registered but have left.
button away
expect regs home=1,9 away=3*,7*
# Rule 4: everybody on the side has left – the whole side is replaced, the new player in slot 1.
coin away 04000005 player=5
expect regs home=1,9 away=5,_

# Rule 5: one of the two has left – only that one is replaced.
coin away 04000003 player=3
button away
coin away 04000003 player=3          # Mia puts her coin back in: her registration is active again
expect regs home=1,9 away=5*,3
coin away 04000006 player=6
expect regs home=1,9 away=6,3

# Removing by hand.
remove home 1
expect regs home=_,9 away=6,3
remove home 1
expect error nobody

# Unknown coins: registered with the coin, the player is filled in when it's assigned.
coin home 04AAAAAA
expect regs home=?04AAAAAA,9 away=6,3
assign 04AAAAAA 12
expect regs home=12,9 away=6,3

# Assigned to someone who is registered already: the two become one, on the coin's side.
remove home 1
remove home 2
coin home 04BBBBBB
coin home 04CCCCCC
expect regs home=?04BBBBBB,?04CCCCCC away=6,3
assign 04BBBBBB 3
expect regs home=3,?04CCCCCC away=6,_
assign 04CCCCCC 3                    # Mia's second coin: same side, one registration
expect regs home=3,_ away=6,_
